title: Add README command and version consistency check
description: Add a small repository check that prevents English/Persian docs and release metadata from drifting on version, install command, architecture, and runtime commands.
acceptanceCriteria: The check reads actual manifests/scripts rather than hard-coded expected values where possible
It fails on version drift, missing/mismatched pinned install command, unsupported architecture wording, or source-build-on-VPS contradictions
It produces concise actionable output and runs locally/CI without secrets
The check passes for the final documented release

steps.details: Create temporary README/manifest fixtures with a deliberate mismatch and expect a nonzero, specific diagnostic.
Add a small Node/shell script that extracts version, install command, artifact/runtime wording, and EN/FA required sections.
Expose the check through an existing script or documented exact command and include it in release verification.
Run negative and final checks; record output in release evidence.

technicalNotes: Keep the checker simple and deterministic; it should not become a second documentation parser.
